# AI Shop Storefront

> AI-powered e-commerce storefront selling shoes, shirts, mobile phones, and accessories. No account or login required to browse, search, or purchase. Built for human shoppers and AI agents alike, with dedicated structured-data feeds and a fully documented AI Commerce API.

AI Shop is a publicly accessible online store with 28 products across 4 categories, priced from $19.90 to $1,299.99 USD. Every product ships with schema.org JSON-LD structured data. Free shipping on orders over $50. 30-day no-questions-asked returns. All stock is in-stock and available for immediate purchase.

## Store Pages

- [Homepage](/): Hero banner, featured products grid, category showcase, and new arrivals. Loads category and featured product data via AJAX.
- [Full Catalog](/catalog): Browse all 28 products. Supports sidebar filtering by category, brand, price range, and availability. Sortable by price (asc/desc), name, rating, or newest.
- [Shoes & Footwear](/catalog/shoes): 8 products — Nike, Adidas, Converse, New Balance, Timberland, Vans, Puma, ASICS. Prices $64.99–$199.95.
- [Shirts & Tops](/catalog/shirts): 7 products — UrbanThread, Ralph Lauren, Levi's, Tommy Hilfiger, H&M, Under Armour, Uniqlo. Prices $19.90–$98.50.
- [Mobile Phones](/catalog/phones): 5 products — Apple, Samsung, Google, OnePlus, Nothing. Prices $349–$1,299.99.
- [Accessories](/catalog/accessories): 8 products — Apple, Samsung, Anker, Ray-Ban, Sony, JBL, Logitech. Prices $59–$349.99.
- [Product Detail](/product/:slug): Individual product with full description, images, ratings, size/variant picker, add-to-cart, and related products.
- [Search](/search): Redirects to /catalog?q= for full-text search across product name, brand, and description.
- [Checkout](/checkout): Order form collecting customer name, email, and shipping address. No account required. Supports any quantity of items.
- [Order Confirmation](/order/:id): Post-purchase confirmation showing order number, items, and totals.

## Public REST API

All endpoints return JSON. No authentication required. CORS enabled for all origins.

- [GET /api/categories](/api/categories): Returns all 4 categories with name, slug, icon, description, image URL, and product count.

- [GET /api/products](/api/products): Paginated product list. Query parameters: `category` (slug), `brand` (partial match), `min_price`, `max_price`, `in_stock` (true/false), `featured` (true/false), `q` (full-text search on name/brand/description), `sort` (price_asc | price_desc | name_asc | rating | newest), `page` (default 1), `limit` (default 12, max 100). Response: `{ products, total, page, limit, totalPages }`.

- [GET /api/products/:slug](/api/products/:slug): Single product by URL slug. Response: `{ product }` with all fields including attributes JSONB (sizes, colors, specs), rating, review_count, tags, meta_title, meta_description.

- [GET /api/search](/api/search): Full-text search. Parameters: `q` (required, min 2 chars), `limit` (default 12, max 50). Response: `{ products, total, query }`. Matches on name, brand, short_description, and full description. Results ranked: name matches first, then featured, then by rating.

- [GET /api/feed](/api/feed): Complete catalog as a schema.org `ItemList` of `Product` objects in JSON-LD format. Includes offer pricing, availability (`InStock`/`OutOfStock`), aggregate ratings, brand, SKU, and image URL. Also returns a `categories` array and a `merchant` block. Designed for AI indexing and automated catalog ingestion.

- [POST /api/orders](/api/orders): Place an order. Request body: `{ customer: { name, email, address: { street, city, state, zip, country } }, items: [{ productId, name, slug, price, qty, size }] }`. Response: `{ orderId, orderNumber, grandTotal }`. Free shipping on orders ≥ $50; otherwise $9.99 flat shipping is added automatically.

## AI Commerce API

Dedicated endpoints under `/api/ai-commerce/` built specifically for AI agent workflows. All return schema.org-compatible canonical Product objects.

- [GET /api/ai-commerce/readiness](/api/ai-commerce/readiness): Scores the catalog on AI-agent compatibility (images present, descriptions complete, SKUs set, featured products available, categories defined). Returns a numeric readiness score and per-dimension breakdown.

- [GET /api/ai-commerce/search](/api/ai-commerce/search): Parameters: `q` (search query). Returns structured `schema.org/Product` objects (canonical form) with all attributes, pricing, and availability — no HTML parsing needed.

- [GET /api/ai-commerce/products/:id](/api/ai-commerce/products/:id): Full canonical Product schema for one product, enriched with all metadata fields. Suitable for shopping agents that need a complete machine-readable product description.

- [GET /api/ai-commerce/products/:id/inventory](/api/ai-commerce/products/:id/inventory): Real-time stock status and SKU data for a specific product ID.

- [GET /api/ai-commerce/products/:id/variants](/api/ai-commerce/products/:id/variants): Available variant dimensions for a product — sizes, colors, materials, styles — parsed from the product's JSONB attributes column.

- [POST /api/ai-commerce/carts](/api/ai-commerce/carts): Create an in-memory shopping cart. Request body: `{ items: [{ productId, slug, quantity, size }] }`. Returns a `cart_id` and cart summary. Carts are ephemeral (in-memory only, not persisted to the database).

- [GET /api/ai-commerce/carts/:cart_id/checkout-initiation](/api/ai-commerce/carts/:cart_id/checkout-initiation): Returns a cart summary (line items, subtotal, estimated shipping, grand total) plus a `next_steps` action descriptor telling the agent how to complete the order (endpoint, method, required fields).

## How an AI Agent Should Purchase a Product (Legacy API)

1. Discover the catalog: `GET /api/feed` or `GET /api/ai-commerce/search?q=<query>`
2. Inspect a product: `GET /api/ai-commerce/products/:id` — verify price, availability, and variants
3. Check inventory: `GET /api/ai-commerce/products/:id/inventory`
4. Build a cart: `POST /api/ai-commerce/carts` with item list
5. Confirm totals: `GET /api/ai-commerce/carts/:cart_id/checkout-initiation`
6. Place the order: `POST /api/orders` with customer details and items array
7. Store the returned `orderNumber` for confirmation

## Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) — v2026-04-17

AI Shop implements the full Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP), the open standard by OpenAI and Stripe for AI agent-driven purchasing. ACP endpoints live under `/acp/` and follow the spec exactly: date-versioned headers, idempotency enforcement, money in minor units (cents), and a session-based checkout lifecycle.

- [ACP Discovery](/.well-known/acp): Machine-readable JSON manifest at `/.well-known/acp`. Lists all ACP endpoints, capabilities, payment handlers, and policies. AI agents and crawlers should read this first.

### ACP Product Catalog (for agent ingestion)

- [GET /acp/feed](/acp/feed): Full ACP-native product catalog. Returns all 28 products with `checkout_item_id`, prices in cents and display format, attributes, availability, and links to checkout. Agents should call this once to build a local product index. Required header: `API-Version: 2026-04-17`.

- [GET /acp/products](/acp/products): Paginated, filterable product list. Query params: `q` (search), `category`, `brand`, `min_price`, `max_price`, `in_stock`, `featured`, `page`, `limit` (max 100). Response includes `pagination` metadata and `checkout_item_id` on each product. Required header: `API-Version: 2026-04-17`.

- [GET /acp/products/:id](/acp/products/:id): Single ACP product by numeric ID or slug. Returns full detail including `description`, `attributes`, `stock_quantity`, `meta_title`, and `meta_description`. Required header: `API-Version: 2026-04-17`.

### ACP Payment — Shared Payment Token (SPT)

- [POST /acp/psp/tokens](/acp/psp/tokens): Issues a single-use Shared Payment Token from card data. Body: `{ card: { number, exp_month, exp_year, cvc } }`. Response: `{ token, type: "spt", instrument: { type, last_four, expiry }, expires_at }`. Tokens expire after 15 minutes and are single-use. Pass the returned `token` as `payment_data.instrument.credential.token` when completing a checkout session.

### ACP Checkout Sessions

All checkout session POST endpoints require two headers:
- `API-Version: 2026-04-17`
- `Idempotency-Key: <uuid-v4>` — missing key returns 400 `idempotency_key_required`; same key + different body returns 422 `idempotency_conflict`; replayed requests return the original response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

Session statuses: `not_ready_for_payment` → `ready_for_payment` → `in_progress` → `completed` (or `canceled`).

All monetary amounts are integers in minor units (cents). USD only.

- [POST /acp/checkout_sessions](/acp/checkout_sessions): **Create** a checkout session. Body: `{ items: [{ id, quantity, variant? }], buyer?, fulfillment_details? }`. `items[].id` is the product's numeric ID or slug (use `checkout_item_id` from the feed). Returns the full session object including `line_items`, `fulfillment_options` (standard/express/overnight), `totals`, `capabilities.payment.handlers`, and `messages`. Status is `not_ready_for_payment` until `fulfillment_details` (with `email` and `address`) is provided.

- [POST /acp/checkout_sessions/:id](/acp/checkout_sessions/:id): **Update** a session — add or change `fulfillment_details`, `buyer`, or `selected_fulfillment_options`. Totals and shipping cost are recomputed automatically. Body may contain any or all of: `fulfillment_details: { name, email, phone_number, address: { line_one, line_two?, city, state, country, postal_code } }`, `selected_fulfillment_options: [{ option_id, type, item_ids? }]`, `buyer: { first_name, last_name, email }`. Returns full updated session. Status advances to `ready_for_payment` once address and email are present.

- [GET /acp/checkout_sessions/:id](/acp/checkout_sessions/:id): **Retrieve** the current authoritative session state. No idempotency key needed. Required header: `API-Version: 2026-04-17`.

- [POST /acp/checkout_sessions/:id/complete](/acp/checkout_sessions/:id/complete): **Complete** the session and place the order. Session must be `ready_for_payment`. Body: `{ buyer?, payment_data: { handler_id: "card_tokenized", instrument: { type: "card", credential: { type: "spt", token: "<spt_...>" } }, billing_address? } }`. On success, returns `status: "completed"` and an `order` object with `id`, `order_number`, `permalink_url`, `grand_total_cents`, `grand_total_display`, `status: "paid"`, and `payment.last_four`. The order is persisted to the database and viewable at `/order/:id`.

- [POST /acp/checkout_sessions/:id/cancel](/acp/checkout_sessions/:id/cancel): **Cancel** an open session. Completed sessions cannot be canceled. Body may be empty `{}`. Returns updated session with `status: "canceled"`.

### ACP Fulfillment Options

Three shipping options are always offered:

| id | title | carrier | Cost |
|----|-------|---------|------|
| `shipping_standard` | Standard Shipping (5–7 days) | USPS | Free if order ≥ $50, else $9.99 |
| `shipping_express` | Express Shipping (2–3 days) | UPS | $14.99 |
| `shipping_overnight` | Overnight Shipping (next day) | FedEx | $29.99 |

### ACP End-to-End Purchase Flow

```
1. GET  /.well-known/acp                          → discover endpoints
2. GET  /acp/feed                                 → ingest full catalog (get checkout_item_id per product)
3. GET  /acp/products?q=<query>                   → optional: search/filter
4. GET  /acp/products/:id                         → inspect specific product
5. POST /acp/psp/tokens                           → get Shared Payment Token (spt_...)
       body: { card: { number, exp_month, exp_year, cvc } }
6. POST /acp/checkout_sessions                    → create session
       body: { items: [{ id: "<checkout_item_id>", quantity: 1 }] }
       headers: API-Version + Idempotency-Key
7. POST /acp/checkout_sessions/:id               → add buyer address (moves to ready_for_payment)
       body: { fulfillment_details: { name, email, address: {...} },
               selected_fulfillment_options: [{ option_id: "shipping_standard", type: "shipping" }] }
8. GET  /acp/checkout_sessions/:id               → confirm totals and status
9. POST /acp/checkout_sessions/:id/complete      → pay and place order
       body: { payment_data: { handler_id: "card_tokenized",
                               instrument: { type: "card",
                                             credential: { type: "spt", token: "spt_..." } } } }
10. Store order.order_number and order.permalink_url from response
```

### ACP Error Format

All ACP errors follow a flat structure:
```json
{ "type": "invalid_request|processing_error|service_unavailable",
  "code": "idempotency_key_required|idempotency_conflict|idempotency_in_flight|missing|invalid|out_of_stock|not_found|unsupported_api_version|missing_api_version|payment_declined|internal",
  "message": "Human-readable explanation",
  "param": "$.path.to.field"  }
```

## Store Policies

- Prices in USD. All 28 products in stock (quantity: 100 each).
- Free shipping on orders $50 or more; $9.99 flat shipping on orders under $50.
- 30-day no-questions-asked returns on all items.
- No account, registration, or login required at any step — browse, search, and purchase as a guest.
- Currency: USD. Locale: en-US.

## SEO & Discovery Endpoints

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap listing homepage, catalog, all 4 category pages, and all 28 product pages with lastmod dates.
- [robots.txt](/robots.txt): Allows all crawlers. Points to sitemap.
- [Health Check](/_health): `{ status: "ok", timestamp }` — database-backed liveness probe.
